name: Hatsujou☆Otome -Ecchi Shitai Dake nan Dakara ne!-
original_name: 発情☆乙女－エッチしたいだけなんだからねっ！－
source:
"Shall we have sex...?" Ryouichi starts working at the hospital on an isolated island. However, there is a girl, Kana, gazing at his penis. Also, a nurse, Tomoka, tries to seduce him... Well, what will happen to his life there...?

[From ErogeShop]
